about: Layout of the whole Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk: every ride and attraction in the 2025 official map legend plus the key buildings, placed on the official map (pdf px) and on OpenStreetMap (lat/lon, ground metres), with the fitted mapping between them, its distortion, and the proposed slices for the painted stage. Built by tests/layout/build_layout.py from tests/layout/layout_data.py.

panorama.note: slice origins sit on a 25 pdf px grid from the panorama origin, so every slice offset is a whole multiple of 64 stage px

seam_hints.why: the main-entrance plaza between Double Shot / Typhoon (x <= 462) and Shockwave (x >= 478); no ride-free vertical corridor exists, so let a min-cut seam wander +-30 px
the only ride-free corridor (792-830): between the Haunted Castle and the Giant Dipper's west loop, down Raymond Street

between the mill house / Dipper east end (x <= 1326) and Ghost Blasters / Rock-O-Plane (x >= 1325); cutting through the Dipper lattice or the flume chute shows, so search a min-cut path +-40 px around it

procedure: Same camera by construction: every slice is a crop of the same official map at the same 2.56 scale, redrawn with the same style frames and prompt template as base/stage.png (add stage.png itself as a style reference).
Grow outward from the existing S2: S1 then S0 to the west, S3 to the east, one at a time.

Input for a new slice: the official-map crop with map graphics removed, the overlap pasted in from the already-painted neighbour (same pdf frame and scale, so it is a pure integer shift by the panorama offsets), and flat platform discs drawn at layout.json bases so rides cannot drift; edit mask = everything except the pasted overlap, minus a 48 px band at its inner edge for blending.

After generation: colour-match the new slice to the neighbour on the overlap, measure any residual shift by phase correlation (re-run if > 8 stage px), cut a minimum-error seam through the overlap near the seam hint, and blend 32-48 px across it.

Register every painted slice back to the official map (10+ landmarks: platforms, building corners, wall stairs) and store its pdf -> slice warp next to its stage.json; reject a slice whose platforms land > 20 stage px from layout.json.
Ship the panorama as the four slices cropped at the seams (WebP tiles placed by panorama_offset); layers keep working in panorama px = (pdf - origin) * 2.56.
